text_block_list.text:
On my way back from running an errand for Chairwoman Akikawa,
Winning Ticket and the others called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Trainer over there!
Have you seen a white snake around here?!
choice_data_list: A white snake?! Haven't seen one, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Another dead end?!
Where the heck are you, white snake~~!!
choice_data_list: Why are you looking for a white snake?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's for a ritual that brings the blessing of good luck!
It's high-tier magic, you know!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?!
choice_data_list: You were helping without even knowing...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
She bolted before I could even explain!
And she keeps charging ahead without a single clue!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... If Grandma were here, she'd probably
find it in a snap using magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course! She's the great witch I aspire to be!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's ask your Grandma
to teach us how to find it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
NOOO! I have to do this myself!
I'm gonna find it with my own power!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Otherwise, I'll never be able
to become like Grandma...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I will make the white snake ritual a success!
And then, I'll become a full-fledged witch!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're chasing your dream with everything you've got!
What a fiery kid you are, seriouslyyyy!!
Thank you for moving me so muchhh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna support your dream with all my might, Sweep!
We are DEFINITELY finding that white snake, no matter whatttt!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! Then resume the search!
You help out too!

And so I got dragged into searching for a white snake...
The three of us searched the hills and fields, but came up empty-handed—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna do this anymore! I wanna go hoooome!
I don't wanna walk anymoreee!!
choice_data_list: Shall we head home for today?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Giving up is completely out of the question!
Let's search the town too!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: There's no way one would be in a place like that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's bet on even a tiny chance!
We haven't given it our absolute all yet!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll help Sweep with everything I've got!
If she's about to break, I'll support her with all my strength!
That's what I decided on, damn itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! It's not like I
said I was giving up either!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sweep...! 
Ehehe, that's the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?! ...Wait a second?
That thing on the general store's shelf is...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: F-Found it—! A white snaaaake~~!!

With geometric patterned scales and glass bead-like eyes,
the snake looked just like a work of art...
No, it was literally a work of art.
choice_data_list: This is a toy/figurine, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A fake?! No way, no waaaay—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaah! I'm so sorry, Sweeeeep!
Even though I swore I'd find one for youuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...This snake is fine already.
The effect will be weaker, but the grimoire said
a doll could serve as a substitute...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, this is even better! I'm going to become a witch,
so mastering a doll like this will be a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sweep... Sweeeeeeeep—!
You can totally do it! You'll become a wonderful witch!!

Having successfully captured (?) a white snake,
everyone parted ways with smiles on their faces!
